title: Pen Over Watercolor
content: Here's a strategy for sketching subjects with a lot of surface complexity.In thisYouTube video, I demo a sketch of a woodpile using fountain pen over loose watercolor washes.It's more common for artists to do the line drawing first, which I presume is how Thomas Girtin did this one.......or this one by John Sell Cotman.The first stages can be remarkably loose, just setting up possibilities for the pen line.I use a few blobs of white acrylic to suggest the bright sun, and add loose, scrubby textures from a house painting brush.Check out the whole presentation in theYouTube video, which contains links for supplies in the description.
